record.bible_text: So the king<WH04428> and Haman<WH02001> came<WH0935><WTH8799> to banquet<WH08354><WTH8800> with Esther<WH0635> the queen<WH04436>. <RF>to banquet: Heb. to drink<Rf>

And the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799> again unto Esther<WH0635> on the second<WH08145> day<WH03117> at the banquet<WH04960> of wine<WH03196>, What <FI>is<Fi> thy petition<WH07596>, queen<WH04436> Esther<WH0635>? and it shall be granted<WH05414><WTH8735> thee: and what <FI>is<Fi> thy request<WH01246>? and it shall be performed<WH06213><WTH8735>, <FI>even<Fi> to the half<WH02677> of the kingdom<WH04438>.

Then Esther<WH0635> the queen<WH04436> answered<WH06030><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, If I have found<WH04672><WTH8804> favour<WH02580> in thy sight<WH05869>, O king<WH04428>, and if it please<WH02895><WTH8804> the king<WH04428>, let my life<WH05315> be given<WH05414><WTH8735> me at my petition<WH07596>, and my people<WH05971> at my request<WH01246>:

For we are sold<WH04376><WTH8738>, I and my people<WH05971>, to be destroyed<WH08045><WTH8687>, to be slain<WH02026><WTH8800>, and to perish<WH06><WTH8763>. But if<WH0432> we had been sold<WH04376><WTH8738> for bondmen<WH05650> and bondwomen<WH08198>, I had held my tongue<WH02790><WTH8689>, although the enemy<WH06862> could not countervail<WH07737><WTH8802> the king's<WH04428> damage<WH05143>. <RF>to be destroyed...: Heb. that they should destroy, and kill, and cause to perish<Rf>

Then the king<WH04428> Ahasuerus<WH0325> answered<WH0559><WTH8799> and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Esther<WH0635> the queen<WH04436>, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume<WH04390><WTH8804> in his heart<WH03820> to do<WH06213><WTH8800> so? <RF>that...: Heb. whose heart hath filled him<Rf>

And Esther<WH0635> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, The adversary<WH0376><WH06862> and enemy<WH0341><WTH8802> <FI>is<Fi> this wicked<WH07451> Haman<WH02001>. Then Haman<WH02001> was afraid<WH01204><WTH8738> before<WH06440> the king<WH04428> and the queen<WH04436>. <RF>The adversary: Heb. The man adversary<Rf> <RF>before: or, at the presence of<Rf><CM>

And the king<WH04428> arising<WH06965><WTH8804> from the banquet<WH04960> of wine<WH03196> in his wrath<WH02534> <FI>went<Fi> into the palace<WH01055> garden<WH01594>: and Haman<WH02001> stood up<WH05975><WTH8804> to make request<WH01245><WTH8763> for his life<WH05315> to Esther<WH0635> the queen<WH04436>; for he saw<WH07200><WTH8804> that there was evil<WH07451> determined<WH03615><WTH8804> against him by the king<WH04428>.

Then the king<WH04428> returned<WH07725><WTH8804> out of the palace<WH01055> garden<WH01594> into the place<WH01004> of the banquet<WH04960> of wine<WH03196>; and Haman<WH02001> was fallen<WH05307><WTH8802> upon the bed<WH04296> whereon Esther<WH0635> <FI>was<Fi> . Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> the king<WH04428>, Will he force<WH03533><WTH8800> the queen<WH04436> also before me in the house<WH01004>? As the word<WH01697> went out<WH03318><WTH8804> of the king's<WH04428> mouth<WH06310>, they covered<WH02645><WTH8804> Haman's<WH02001> face<WH06440>. <RF>before me: Heb. with me<Rf>

And Harbonah<WH02726>, one<WH0259> of the chamberlains<WH05631>, said<WH0559><WTH8799> before<WH06440> the king<WH04428>, Behold also, the gallows<WH06086> fifty<WH02572> cubits<WH0520> high<WH01364>, which Haman<WH02001> had made<WH06213><WTH8804> for Mordecai<WH04782>, who had spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> good<WH02896> for the king<WH04428>, standeth<WH05975><WTH8802> in the house<WH01004> of Haman<WH02001>. Then the king<WH04428> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Hang<WH08518><WTH8798> him thereon. <RF>gallows: Heb. tree<Rf>

So they hanged<WH08518><WTH8799> Haman<WH02001> on the gallows<WH06086> that he had prepared<WH03559><WTH8689> for Mordecai<WH04782>. Then was the king's<WH04428> wrath<WH02534> pacified<WH07918><WTH8804>.<CM>
